pages.text: Iron's Spellbooks gives you 9 schools of magic, a mana bar, and a spell slot system.$(br2)Your $(bold)mana bar$() appears near the hunger bar (right side) when you're casting or below max mana. It refills over time.

$(bold)How to cast:$() Equip a spellbook in your offhand or mainhand, then right-click. To switch between spells in a book, scroll while holding it (or use the spell wheel key).$(br2)$(bold)Getting spells:$() Find scrolls and spellbooks in loot chests. Craft scrolls at a Scroll Forge (iron + paper + arcane essence). Upgrade scrolls at an Arcane Anvil.

$(bold)Starting gear:$() The Wandering Magician armor set is good for early magic builds — find pieces in village chests and dungeon loot. It boosts spell power and mana regen.$(br2)$(bold)Mana regen:$() Default regen is 1.0x. Standing still or sneaking doesn't speed it up. Plan your combat around cooldowns, not mana pooling.
